missing_evidence: Inventory logs/traces showing which configuration key was rejected and the resulting failure path
Confirmation that configuration rejections, not another fault, cause the inventory checkout errors
candidates.statement: Inventory 3.3.7 runs with an invalid configuration revision (cfg-119, configuration_valid=false), producing 14 configuration rejections, 9 configuration_value_rejected ERROR logs with status 503, and a 10% error rate; inventory checkout spans error at 1350ms, propagating to gateway's errored 'call inventory' span.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; order and payment checkout spans are OK, so scope is bounded to inventory configuration handling.

report.explanation: Inventory shows invalid configuration (cfg-119), configuration rejections, and 503 configuration_value_rejected errors with elevated error rate, while its checkout span errors and gateway's inventory call errors. Order and payment checkout spans are OK. Gateway metrics/logs are healthy, so no gateway-side fault is supported. Bounded candidate: bad-configuration in inventory.
